dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast, light-colored perimeters with sharp gradient transitions from dark exterior backgrounds to dark interior centers; geometries range from near-circular to irregular hexagonal polygons.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid low-intensity pixel clusters acting as centers for macro-annuli, with concentrated groupings of small, dark, asymmetrical spots in the anterior-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal section form an obtuse scalene triangle; a cluster of smaller rings in the anterior region forms a tight, honeycomb-like polygonal network.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of high-intensity, linear, hair-like structures (vibrissae) is visible extending from the lower-right ventral-anterior boundary.
